verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart documents a first-party `custom_vocabulary_config` request parameter that takes a list of domain terms (e.g. "Gladia", "Solaria", "Salesforce"), which directly delivers custom vocabulary for names and jargon. Custom spelling is a related post-processing normalizer, so it adds only secondary support. missing for 10: in-depth docs on boost weighting, intensity, pronunciation hints or vocabulary limits; evidence that custom vocabulary works for live/real-time transcription; independent or hands-on accuracy corroboration.
